title: Getting started with quarBreach
text: quarBreach lets explore Zachreson et al. (2022) quarantine model’s key parameter interactions. central question: combination vaccine efficacy community coverage expected time community outbreak shift dramatically — R0 move cliff?

title: Getting started with quarBreach
Getting started with quarBreach
text: breach_scenarios contains four scenarios Table 1 paper. key result: fully vaccinated Delta pathway returns exactly 2020 benchmark — headroom vaccines expected buy gone. outbreak_timing records t95 (days community outbreak 95% likely breach) across grid efficacy x coverage x R0 values.

title: Getting started with quarBreach
text: app two controls: R0 (radio buttons): switches Delta (6) stress-test (10). Move see higher transmissibility shifts cliff. Vaccine efficacy (slider): drag 60% watch heat map turn red regardless coverage. Community coverage (slider): high coverage helps efficacy also high — efficacy coverage complements, substitutes.

title: Getting started with quarBreach
text: heat map shows t95 every efficacy x coverage combination. jump red green within column cliff — 60% efficacy whole map stays red regardless coverage. bar chart shows four scenarios Table 1. Delta unvaccinated 3x 2020 baseline. fully vaccinated Delta pathway lands back 1x — exactly unvaccinated travellers 2020.
